ModMetaData.name: Universal Squeaker
ModMetaData.author: Coahuilite
ModMetaData.description:
为任何种族接入语音包的通用内核。Universal Squeaker 本身不含任何语音内容：它提供路由表（把第三方语音包按种族/异种域挂到 pawn 上）、分层调音（全局/种族/异种三级覆盖）、距离衰减曲线、心情调制、彩蛋门与相机指示器，并附带 usdiag 诊断协议。从启动主菜单或原版设置中的“US 语音”入口打开同一窗口：语音管理首页集中管理语音包，次级“设置与工具”提供编辑器，页头“本页帮助”可展开或收起，打开后跟随字段悬浮并保留阅读内容。原 Mod Settings 入口仍可用于恢复访问。需要前置模组 Harmony 和 FerriteLib。
Universal Squeaker is a voice-pack routing kernel for any race. It ships no audio itself: it provides a routing table (attaching third-party voice packs to pawns by race/xenotype domain), layered tuning (global/race/xenotype overrides), distance attenuation curves, mood modulation, easter-egg gating, and a camera indicator — with a built-in usdiag diagnostics protocol. Open the same window through US Voices in the startup menu or vanilla Options: the voice-management home manages packs, secondary Settings & tools pages hold the editors, and page-header help toggles open or closed, follows field hover while open, and holds its last content for reading. The original Mod Settings route remains available to restore access. Requires the Harmony and FerriteLib prerequisite mods.
